description: Defined medium M20 (20 amino acids), phosphate-buffered; grouped substrates fructose/sucrose/levan/FOSmix at 5 g/L — medium reported in PMC4428435, extracted for GrowthDB and mapped to BiGG.

provenance.citation: Medium composition from PMC4428435 (see GrowthDB record).
provenance.notes: Composition mapped to BiGG (mapper + salt dissociation); presence-based bounds; paper_amount retained. Added via GrowthDB curation.
provenance.verification_evidence: "medium 20 (M20): 20 amino acids, modified from Lahtvee et al. (33)". coverage_source.definition: pct_covered_all = components / (components + unresolved ingredients) — the legacy metric, which counts pipeline-derived components as covered. pct_covered_source = source-stated components / (those + unresolved ingredients + ingredients replaced by derived components). Component classes come from tools/component_evidence_classes.tsv. A null value means the denominator was zero; it does not mean 100.
